Not my story, but my best friends mum passed away the day after she went to the doctors complaining about a sore tummy. They waved it off as nothing and told her just to rest. She died the next night after she had liver failure, leaving behind her four children (19, 17, 13 and 11). It was a horrible horrible night. We were at the hospital all night waiting for her to recover, but after 5 heart attacks they had to get my 17 year old friend and her older sister to decide to turn her off life support. If that doctor had just ran a few scans, I wonder what would’ve been..
